context: An aunt and nephew chat in the park
purpose: Teach: 漂っ/見当たら/神さま/ひまわり/ペットボトル/なぞ/吸う/はじまっ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お花の香り、公園に、漂ってるね、爽やか。
lines.en: Sho — do you smell that? The flowers in the park are so fresh.
lines.style: Soft, attentive voice noticing something small. Gentle turn of the head toward him. Warm but not effusive. The tone of someone sharing a quiet moment, not performing it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくのボール、見当たらないんだ、一緒に探して?
lines.en: Mei-sis, I can't find my ball. Will you help me look?
lines.style: Earnest and direct, slightly urgent without being demanding. Small voice but clear. A child asking an adult he trusts, not whining. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 七夕、神さまにお願い、書いた?翔くんの願いごと。
lines.en: Did you write your wish for Tanabata? Tell me what you wished for.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, soft and inviting. Leaning in slightly. No pressure — the tone of someone who wants to know what matters to him, not testing him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ひまわり、お庭で育ててるんだ、ぼく、毎日、お水あげてるよ。
lines.en: I'm growing sunflowers in my garden, and I water them every single day.
lines.style: Pride in his small voice. Measured, deliberate pace — he's showing something he built. Soft but certain. The confidence of a six-year-old who knows he did this right.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ペットボトル、ちゃんと、ゴミ箱に、入れようね。
lines.en: Remember to put your plastic bottles in the trash, okay?
lines.style: Gentle direction, not an order. Light and natural, the way an older sibling or trusted adult reminds without making it feel like scolding. Warm underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お友達の質問、ぼくにとって、なぞだらけだったよ。
lines.en: My friend asked me a question I didn't understand at all.
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful. A small laugh underneath — not mocking himself, just the resignation of being confused. Matter-of-fact delivery. A child processing something that didn't make sense.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 外で、深呼吸、吸うと、頭がスッキリするね、翔くん。
lines.en: When we breathe deeply outside like this, doesn't your head feel clearer, Sho?
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering. Breath gently present in the voice. Slow and deliberate, sharing an observation rather than teaching. The tone of someone breathing the fresh air with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 夏休みのお出かけ、今日から、はじまったよ、メイ姉さん!
lines.en: Mei-sis, summer break started today! We're really going on an outing!
lines.style: Bright, genuine excitement barely contained. Quick pace, words tumbling forward. The joy of a six-year-old who can't quite believe something good is happening right now. Open, unguarded delight.
